en: Black-and-white image showing a large Romanesque-style stone church with a massive square bell tower topped by a steep spire. The nave has small round-arched windows and attached lower buildings; there is a smaller secondary tower further back. Trees, bushes, and a small square or forecourt with paths and low hedges surround the church. No visible printed title or caption appears on the front.
